about: Verified office history for San Francisco's citywide elective offices (Mayor, District Attorney, City Attorney, Sheriff, Treasurer, Assessor-Recorder, Public Defender), one row per term including appointed, interim and acting terms. Every row cites a source URL and a quote that `python3 pipeline/roster.py verify` finds in the cached source (data/raw/offices/). Official sources are City pages (sf.gov, sfmayor.org, sfbos.org minutes, department sites), current or archived by the Internet Archive; Wikipedia is used only as a pointer for exact days, noted in date_note. The succession of each office is complete from 2009-01-01 to as_of, so anyone not listed held none of these offices in 2009-2026. Temporary service as Acting Mayor while the Mayor is out of the state (Charter) is not counted.

roles.elected: took office after winning an election
roles.appointed: appointed to fill a vacancy (most were later elected; see how)
roles.interim: appointed to serve only until an election winner or a returning officeholder took office
roles.acting: performed the duties of the office by operation of the Charter

known_vacancies.note: Seat vacant between Ting's move to the Assembly and Chu's appointment; the office was run by staff.
